title: Synchronize agent and view state (Experimental)
goal: Keep a curator’s caption and an assistant’s proposed caption coordinated when both can change the same museum record; use typed state and an explicit accept/reject boundary with the experimental AG-UI integration.

selectionNotes: Experimental documentation-based recipe; expected behaviour is source-reviewed, not executed. Matching-SDK compilation is recorded separately where the actual contract is available.

prerequisites: Save every listed canonical file in its own directory. Restore package pins/lock before offline builds. Directory files isolate repository inheritance. Read Evidence before treating any example as verified.
constraints: Same experimental Components.AI package as the conversation components. AG-UI is required for the remote state protocol; ordinary IChatClient text is not shared-state proof.

The only compiled rendering mode here is Interactive Server with prerender disabled. Rendering, event flow, provider authentication, network failure/retry and concurrent-agent behaviour are untested. Do not infer WASM/Hybrid, trimming/AOT or GA support.

This sample accepts complete snapshots and rejects deltas. Its disabled-editor policy avoids concurrent local edits; unrelated clients require server-side revision/authorization enforcement. The pending baseline is displayed only, not durable saved data.
No runtime or performance claims. After building, running the current app still requires a separately configured AG-UI endpoint; the compilation record does not qualify that integration.
